meta.data_by: ONYPHE (category:ctiscan for IPs, category:ctiurl for domains)
meta.method: Passive. The tracker reads ONYPHE scan data and never connects to a listed host; this repository only reads the tracker's public exports. Two independent fingerprint families on one IP make it confirmed, one makes it probable. Honeypots and IPs answering on 150 ports or more are dropped. Active = seen in the last 7 days.
meta.caveat: A listed IP runs an exposed instance; that says nothing about who runs it or why (researchers, students, penetration testers and attackers all appear). A CDN-front IP is shared by unrelated sites: search the domain instead. A cloud IP can change owner within minutes: compare log dates with first and last seen. Counts are IPs, not machines. Clusters are a shared build detail, not an attribution.
